$comment: Acceptance criteria for GitHub issue 52 (CI and release pipelines). Declared at admission so STOP_COMPLETE is reachable -- without criteria the engine can never say this work is finished, and the completion firewall (section 40) has nothing to fire on. NOTE what these checks CANNOT express: acceptance condition 1 in the issue is 'the runner exits non-zero when a suite fails, proven by mutation', and a passing command_exit only shows the green half. The mutation proof is a human act recorded in the PR, not a predicate here. Criteria that quietly assert less than the issue does are how a completion bar goes vacuous.
